# Forbidden-path tripwire: agent-machinery paths that must never reappear.
#
# Each non-comment line is an extended regex matched against every tracked path
# (git ls-files). A match fails the build even if the file is empty, because the
# PATH itself is the regression, not its content. This is the scan the content
# grep could not do.

^agent/
^functions/
(^|/)scout\.yml$
(^|/)reviewer\.yml$
(^|/)scout-prompt\.md$
(^|/)reviewer-prompt\.md$
(^|/)SKILLS\.md$
(^|/)projects-context\.md$
(^|/)sources\.yaml$
(^|/)agent-ci-settings\.json$
(^|/)AGENT\.md$
